comment: Government ownership of “core registries and the data they hold” is presented as the relevant safeguard. Legal ownership may not be the only or best concept for personal data, and registries may be operated through federated arrangements.

anchor.note: p.103 l.Lines 589-590 read as the printed page; section 4.6.3 agrees

public.text: Government ownership of “core registries and the data they hold” is presented as the relevant safeguard. Legal ownership may not be the only or best concept for personal data, and registries may be operated through federated arrangements.
public.suggestedRevision: Use the concepts of public accountability, stewardship, control, lawful processing, access, portability, and continuity rather than relying only on ownership.
